rules.statement: A Viharadhipati does not forfeit his right to the office when he leaves the temple of which he is Viharadhipati and takes up residence in another of which he is also Viharadhipati.
rules.supporting_quote: "The office of Viharadhipati is not one that can be abandoned by mere residence in another place. There is nothing in the Vinaya or the decisions of this Court which requires a Viharadhipati to reside in the temple of which he is Viharadhipati."
